name: Virginia MetalFab
old_description: Virginia MetalFab has been in the metal fabrication industry since 2002, always striving to offer quality products in a timely manner for our customers. But it has always been about a lot more than just that for us. We believe that in order to provide such a quality service we must always be striving for excellence on a personal level, being involved in and contributing to our community, and working toward the success of our customers.
about:
Virginia MetalFab was founded in 2002 in Appomattox, Virginia, as a family-owned business serving the equine industry with custom manufactured products. The company has since expanded its scope while remaining under family ownership guided by Christian faith-based values.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including fiber laser cutting, sheet metal forming, high-speed turret punching, tube laser cutting, welding, and powder coating. Equipment includes Amada press brakes and an Amada turret punch press, enabling production from custom one-off projects to larger assembly runs.

Virginia MetalFab serves customers in the energy, utilities, transportation, and technology sectors. Referenced clients include Stadco, ShieldCo, and Accredited Home Elevator, illustrating a base that spans industrial manufacturing, signage, and elevator systems.

The company traces its start to a desire to supply high-quality equine products and now defines success by its customers' success, emphasizing a partnership approach, intentionality, and professionalism rooted in its family-owned culture.
